name: Azure Retail Prices API - ND96isr H100 v5 (eastus)
notes: Microsoft's public Retail Prices API, which is the machine-readable source behind the Azure pricing pages. Filter serviceName eq 'Virtual Machines' and armRegionName eq 'eastus' and contains(meterName,'ND96isr'). Linux/Consumption results for eastus: ND96isr H100 v5 on-demand $98.32/instance-hour (8x H100 = $12.29/H100); Spot $18.169536 (= $2.27/H100); Low Priority $19.664. A second on-demand meter for the same SKU reads $102.736 and Windows meters read $102.736 - the API returns multiple meters per SKU and the Linux no-pre-installed-software one ($98.32) is the number used. Reservation meter: $551,221/h (a normalised 1-year rate; dividing by 8766 gives ~$62.88/h, a ~36% discount, which is the number a 1-year reservation is worth). filter URL: https://prices.azure.com/api/retail/prices?$filter=serviceName%20eq%20'Virtual%20Machines'%20and%20armRegionName%20eq%20'eastus'%20and%20contains(meterName,'ND96isr')
